title: Merge Interval Gaps
description: You're given a list of intervals, where each interval is a pair [start, end]. Your task is to return the total number of integer points that do NOT fall inside any interval. Assume the range of all points is from the smallest start to the largest end across all intervals.
input_spec: List of intervals [[start1, end1], [start2, end2], ...] where -10^6 <= start, end <= 10^6 and start <= end
output_spec: Integer: total number of points not covered by any interval
